specification.objective: MAGI-002: return accurate complete/partial/failed outcomes for pending approve/reject decisions with per-item results and cleanup failures, and show partial results in Desktop.

requirements.statement: API result includes outcome complete|partial|failed, attempted/applied/rejected/failed counts and items with id,status,error as relevant.
success is true only if entire selected operation completes; preserve legacy output and successful paths.
A memory mutation succeeding before pending-file cleanup fails must produce applied_cleanup_failed and never report full success.
Desktop runDecision/decide distinguish all three outcome values and retain visibility of completed items.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Backend regressions verify all success, all failed and partial approve/reject, totals and item statuses.
A cleanup failure after successful native mutation returns applied_cleanup_failed with error and partial/failed outcome.
Desktop uses returned outcome instead of generic success display, handles 200 partial and preserves legacy output.
Regressions, POLIS gates and verify.sh pass and the contract is documented in Magi 1.7.8.

invariants.statement: No direct writes to Hermes MEMORY.md/USER.md or private-method overrides.
Approval and rejection require explicit action and only return confirmed successes.

forbidden_states.statement: success true if any selected record fails or cleanup is incomplete.
Desktop reports a partial or failed batch as full success.

inputs.statement: TASKS.md MAGI-002 and present dashboard/plugin_api.py decision endpoint behavior.

outputs.statement: Structured decision API and updated Desktop feedback with regression tests.

failure_semantics.statement: HTTP 200 may communicate partial batch outcome; failure details must not invent successful persistence.
